front: Single and repeated roots of a polynomial graph
back: A single factor (x − p): the curve crosses at x = p. A repeated factor (x − p)²: the curve touches the axis and turns back.
Leading coefficient positive: bottom-left to top-right. Negative: top-left to bottom-right.

front: How does a sketch help solve f(x) = g(x)?
back: Sketch y = f(x) and y = g(x); the number of intersections is the number of real solutions, and their x-coordinates locate them.
Sketch: shape and labelled key features, freehand. Plot/draw: accurate points on graph paper.
